pickupDescHtml: A list of personal works I have created.</br>A few are highlighted per category.
allDescHtml: A list of personal works I have created.</br>I create across a wide range of areas including games, 3DCG, tools, web, and sound.

sections.descHtml: In addition to developing and running websites, I also build and operate simple APIs myself.</br>On my technical blog "Elekibear Blog", I have posted about 300 articles.

works.title: Elekibear Blog
works.overview: A technical blog sharing information about 3DCG and game development.
works.descHtml: A technical blog sharing information about 3DCG and game development.</br>I strive to lower the technical barrier by explaining things alongside relaxed characters.

works.title: Plasmo Portal
works.overview: The site (this page) created to consolidate personal activities.
works.descHtml: The site (this page) created to consolidate personal activities.</br>Created with a simple structure using Astro and Three.js.

works.title: General-Purpose Ranking API
works.overview: A general-purpose ranking API implemented in Go.
works.descHtml: A general-purpose ranking API implemented in Go.</br>Deployed on a VPS server and used by various self-made apps.

sections.descHtml: I have released 6 apps for iOS/Android.</br>I'm also planning to develop a console game.

works.title: Chocolate Thief
works.overview: A 3D action game created for Valentine's Day. Released within about 2 weeks with a focus on development efficiency.
works.descHtml: A 3D action game created for Valentine's Day.</br>Since development needed to be speed-focused, I had a friend handle pixel art and sound production, and released within about 2 weeks.

works.title: Loose Reversi
works.overview: A 3D Reversi game to enjoy with laid-back characters. Developed while systematically learning the basics of game AI.
works.descHtml: A 3D Reversi game to enjoy with laid-back characters.</br>Developed while systematically learning the basics of game AI.</br>Implemented an AI combining MiniMax, Monte Carlo, and reinforcement learning with ML-Agents.

works.title: Eleki Shooting 3D
works.overview: A 3D shooting game where you defeat crabs. Implemented with minimal external libraries to learn Unity's core features.
works.descHtml: A 3D shooting game where you defeat crabs.</br>After creating a game in C++ for learning purposes, I ported it to Unity.</br>Implemented with minimal external libraries to learn the core features. (※Except DOTween)

works.title: Whac-A-Mole AR
works.overview: A whack-a-mole game you can play in AR. Moles (and occasionally hedgehogs) appear within the detected floor area.
works.descHtml: A whack-a-mole game you can play in AR.</br>Moles (and occasionally hedgehogs) appear within the detected floor area.

works.title: Mag Tower
works.overview: A mini-game where you stack magnets endlessly. Features localization and Google Play Games integration.
works.descHtml: A mini-game where you stack magnets endlessly.</br>Implemented while observing actual magnet behavior.</br>Features localization and ranking management via Google Play Games.

works.title: Go Go Goloyan
works.overview: A 2D action game starring a character named Goloyan. Features a story with ending, 5 full episodes.
works.descHtml: A 2D action game starring a character named Goloyan.</br>This was the first app I ever released personally.</br>Features a story with ending, 5 full episodes, and a time attack mode.

works.title: Cat Runner
works.overview: A mini-game created mainly in C++ for learning Unreal Engine. Contains the minimum elements necessary for game development.
works.descHtml: A mini-game created mainly in C++ for learning Unreal Engine.</br>It covers the minimum elements needed for game development, making it useful for engineers familiar with other game engines who are trying Unreal Engine for the first time.

sections.descHtml: I am studying CG production and related tool development.</br>I focus on improving my expressive capabilities using Houdini.

works.title: Comic Render HDA
works.overview: An HDA that creates comic-style rendering and speech bubbles from scene information in Copernicus.
works.descHtml: Created an HDA that performs comic-style rendering from scene information in Copernicus.</br>After toon-shading using color and normal information, tones are assigned based on threshold values.</br>Additionally created an HDA for creating speech bubbles.

works.title: Mardini2026 Works
works.overview: Works created for "Mardini2026", a contest hosted by SideFX. Posted at a pace of 2-3 days per week.
works.descHtml: Works created for "Mardini2026", a contest hosted by SideFX.</br>Posted at a pace of 2-3 days per week, challenging myself while trying new things.

works.title: Mardini2025 Works
works.overview: Works created for "Mardini2025", a contest hosted by SideFX. Posted all 31 days.
works.descHtml: Works created for "Mardini2025", a contest hosted by SideFX.</br>Since I was still new to Houdini, I completed all 31 days of posts while learning each feature.</br>On DAY23, I was selected as the daily 2nd place.

works.title: Ferris Wheel Generation HDA
works.overview: An HDA that generates a Ferris wheel model. The shape and color can be changed procedurally.
works.descHtml: An HDA that generates a Ferris wheel model.</br>Using VEX to generate the model from edges.</br>The shape and color can be changed procedurally.

sections.descHtml: I create tools across a wide range — desktop, game engine, and web.</br>Most of them were made to solve challenges in my own daily work.

works.title: Command Launcher
works.overview: A general-purpose launcher tool for registering and running scripts. Can be used for switching between multiple DCC tool environments.
works.descHtml: A general-purpose launcher tool for registering and running batch files, shell scripts, and more.</br>With category organization and argument settings, it can be used for switching between multiple DCC tool environments.

works.title: Image Resize & Save Tool (Improved)
works.overview: A tool for resizing and saving images, created for blog writing. Works as a VS Code extension.
works.descHtml: A tool for resizing and saving images, created for blog writing.</br>Developed as a VS Code extension so it works by directly dragging and dropping into Markdown files.

works.title: CSV Editor Tool
works.overview: A tool for editing CSV data, created for blog writing. Works as a desktop application.
works.descHtml: A tool for editing CSV data, created for blog writing.</br>Features a display format specialized for data used in the blog.

works.title: Image Resize & Save Tool
works.overview: A tool for resizing and saving images, created for blog writing. Works as a desktop application.
works.descHtml: A tool for resizing and saving images, created for blog writing.</br>Designed with a simple UI that's immediately understandable at a glance.</br>Developed using Electron and Vue.js, which I had not used before.

works.title: Slideshow Creator Tool
works.overview: A slideshow creation tool utilizing Unity's Timeline.
works.descHtml: A slideshow creation tool utilizing Unity's Timeline.</br>Developed to handle nearly 500 images needed for a proposal video.</br>By basing it on Excel data for efficiency, I was able to complete it in about 2 weeks.

works.title: English Vocabulary Study App
works.overview: An app that generates 4-choice English vocabulary quizzes from settings data.
works.descHtml: An app that generates 4-choice English vocabulary quizzes from settings data.</br>Data can be configured via Google Spreadsheets, so no rebuild is needed.

works.title: Floor Plan Dimension Calculator
works.overview: A tool that calculates approximate dimensions from floor plan images.
works.descHtml: A tool that calculates approximate dimensions from floor plan images.</br>Created from my own experience of forgetting to measure dimensions.

sections.descHtml: I study shader implementation, various simulations, and rendering topics.</br>I enjoy expanding expression through code and am also interested in fractals.

works.title: Back-Face Toon Shader
works.overview: A toon shader implemented in Three.js. The outline is rendered using the back-face method.
works.descHtml: A toon shader implemented in Three.js.</br>The outline is rendered using the back-face method.</br>Also supports hard-edge models.

works.title: Wave Function Collapse Algorithm
works.overview: An implementation sample of the Wave Function Collapse algorithm. Can automatically extract patterns from input images and generate new content.
works.descHtml: An implementation sample of the Wave Function Collapse algorithm.</br>Can automatically extract patterns from input images and generate new content.

works.title: Pink Panther Cell Division
works.overview: An art piece using the Julia set. Created on Shadertoy.
works.descHtml: An art piece using the Julia set.</br>Creates unique shapes by animating parameters.</br>Created on Shadertoy.

works.title: Boids Simulation
works.overview: A fish school simulation sample using Boids. Calculations are performed with ComputeShader.
works.descHtml: A fish school simulation sample using Boids.</br>Both 2D and 3D samples are provided.</br>Calculations are performed with ComputeShader.

works.title: 3D Fluid Simulation (SPH)
works.overview: A fluid simulation sample using SPH with ComputeShader. Rendering uses ray marching.
works.descHtml: A fluid simulation sample using SPH with ComputeShader.</br>Both 2D and 3D simulations are provided.</br>Rendering uses ray marching.

sections.descHtml: Drawing on my experience playing in a band, I compose music myself.</br>I have also taken on challenges in waveform manipulation and middleware implementation.

works.title: Watanabe Distortion
works.overview: A distortion VST/AU plugin for use with various DAW software.
works.descHtml: A distortion VST/AU plugin for use with various DAW software.</br>Manipulates waveforms to produce 2 types of distortion.</br>Created using JUCE.

works.title: Sound Middleware Integration
works.overview: Implemented a design that doesn't depend on sound middleware (CRI/Wwise) in Unity, along with samples.
works.descHtml: Implemented a design that doesn't depend on sound middleware (CRI/Wwise) in Unity.</br>Additional samples include object manipulation in sync with beats and interactive music.
